latest_release.body:
Memos 26.11.1 adds Markup for drawings and image annotations, a full emoji reaction picker, and a refreshed interface. Attachment browsing, editing reliability, and sign-in forms also improve.

## Highlights

* **Markup:** Sketch in a memo or annotate an image while keeping the original. Drawings save as ordinary PNG attachments with their editable scene embedded, and reopening them preserves the view when switching between viewing and editing. ([#6533](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6533), [image annotation](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/bbd0d35a251a9df4f449c86f95dc3430d766991f))
* **Attachments:** The composer and saved memo use the same gallery and file-row layout. Reorder attachments by dragging, long-pressing on touch, or using Alt and the arrow keys. ([attachment layout](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/038c1fef12cfb0d2847a916dafbbd44f4b31e7f7))
* **Reactions:** Choose any Unicode emoji through a searchable picker. Existing reactions remain available. ([emoji reactions](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/5f3969a8300d4aee219160f7ea277c6dfefe6e9e))

## Fixes and polish

* **Editor:** Custom app links keep their targets, pasting URLs inside inline code preserves the code formatting, and Japanese IME conversion retains committed text and caret positions. Markdown mode keeps a transparent background and no longer shows a label beside Save or Update. ([#6540](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6540), [#6567](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6567), [#6564](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6564), [Markdown appearance](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/938ceae84223a0a7be77720359f2dabdacf97bb8))
* **Memo updates:** Rapid edits, pin changes, reactions, and Space moves keep the latest state when requests overlap. ([#6526](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6526), [#6565](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6565))
* **Interface:** Controls and settings share consistent sizing and styling. Memo content has clearer spacing and dark-mode contrast, tags support keyboard activation, and the icon picker stays in place while searching or switching tabs. ([#6528](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6528), [control sizing](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/063fafb81852a6e0da1392dea98a488b52efcf2f), [memo readability](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/4a0c5cfaf52390c20fbf16db37fad9cd6c32ab27), [keyboard tags](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/390797ed1af353810ad336fac2093ea2156f6deb), [icon picker](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/abe2a05c5e7897212a05b47c3ebab67e90759645))
* **Account forms:** Cancelling account, member, or password edits clears those changes before the dialog reopens. A later role change no longer submits a previously cancelled password. ([#6566](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6566))
* **Sign-in:** Errors appear inside the form, passwords have a show/hide control, and theme and language choices stay within the sign-in layout. Closed registration redirects to sign-in with a notice. ([sign-in pages](https://github.com/usememos/memos/commit/eb8a04111c5f9f6a636309cb3cfe0e9d44416156))
* **Markdown:** Snippets preserve spaces at hard line breaks and count characters correctly when truncating. ([#6534](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6534))

## Administration and integrations

* **Attachment performance:** New indexes speed attachment lookups and the With attachments and Photos filters, including instances that store attachment bytes in the database. ([#6536](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6536))
* **Security:** Updated Go and HTML parsing dependencies include security fixes and prevent excessive CPU use when fetching malicious link previews. ([#6558](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6558), [#6565](https://github.com/usememos/memos/pull/6565))
* **Deployment:** Missing static assets return `Cache-Control: no-store`, preventing caches from retaining those 404 responses after a deployment. ([static asset caching]

detail.readme:
> ✨ Featured sponsor: [CodeRabbit — Industry-leading AI code reviews](https://coderabbit.link/usememos).

### Simple note-taking for your everyday thoughts. Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share. [Demo](https://demo.usememos.com) · [Install](#quick-start) · [Docs](https://usememos.com/docs) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv) [![Docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/neosmemo/memos?style=flat-square&logo=docker)](https://hub.docker.com/r/neosmemo/memos) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/usememos/memos?style=flat-square&label=Release)](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases) ## About Memos Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app for your everyday thoughts. - **Everyday writing.** A single sentence can be a whole memo, or you can take your time with a longer entry, using Markdown to give your words more structure. - **A personal timeline.** Each memo stays with the day you wrote it, bringing your thoughts together in a timeline you can look back through. Tags connect related thoughts across those days, making it easy to pick up a topic again or find something you remember writing. - **Your own data.** Your record lives on your own server, and your data stays yours. - **Sharing you control.** You choose what stays private, what to share with family and friends, and what to publish on the web. In shared spaces, you can write alongside others while each person keeps their own memos. ## Quick start With Docker installed, run: ```bash docker run -d \ --name memos \ -p 5230:5230 \ -v ~/.memos:/var/opt/memos \ neosmemo/memos:stable ``` Open http://localhost:5230 and create the first account. Everything Memos keeps is in `~/.memos`, so back up that one folder. Other ways to run Memos, including Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and a plain binary, are in the [deployment guide](https://usememos.com/docs/deploy). ## Upgrading Releases are tagged `YY.MM.N`, with release candidates as `YY.MM.N-rc.K` and no `v` prefix. The Docker tag `stable` follows stable releases, a month tag such as `26.10` follows the newest stable release of that month, and `canary` follows development builds. Coming from a release before v0.31.0, run [v0.31.0](https://github.com/usememos/memos/releases/tag/v0.31.0) once first; see the [upgrade requirements](store/migration/README.md). ## Around Memos - [Web Clipper](https://usememos.com/web-clipper) for [Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/memos-web-clipper/nebaoebnljalfegiidibihhkebeiklbl) and [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/memos-web-clipper/) saves pages, selections, and images to your memos as Markdown with a link to the source. - [Memogram](https://github.com/usememos/telegram-integration) is a Telegram bot that saves your messages and images to Memos. - The [API](https://usememos.com/docs/api/latest) and [MCP server](https://usememos.com/docs/integrations/mcp) connect Memos to your own scripts and AI tools. ## Sponsors

      

Sponsor Memos through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/usememos). ## Help and contributing Questions go to the [docs](https://usememos.com/docs), [Discord](https://discord.gg/tfPJa4UmAv), or [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/usememos/memos/discussions). Bugs and ideas go to [issues](https://github.com/usememos/memos/issues/new/choose). Code changes start with the [contributing guide](https://usememos.com/docs/development/contributing). ## Star History
